ops.sql: SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name, o.Package_ID, p.Name AS PackageName, o.CreatedDate FROM t_object o INNER JOIN t_package p ON p.Package_ID = o.Package_ID WHERE o.Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND o.Name LIKE 'FB %' AND o.CreatedDate >= '2026-09-09' ORDER BY o.Object_ID
SELECT Package_ID, Name, Parent_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (685, 687) ORDER BY Package_ID
